summary: Preserve workflow event and repository authority bindings

delivery.outcome: Repair the two currently reproduced adoption binding defects: classify checks from the actual pull_request event and its own activity types, and preserve identity-significant SSH authorities in registered ticket allocation. Join material patch0.20.126 and use native protected review, merge and immutable publication.
nonGoals: Change foreign source393, consumer heads, protected review policy, dependencies or hosted required-check contexts.
Implement a general YAML parser, infer branch protection coverage, grant cleanup or campaign replay authority.

architecture.decision: Keep existing public function/CLI signatures. Parse a conservative literal workflow trigger subset and inspect only on.pull_request and its direct types field; comments, scalar payloads and sibling events cannot contribute. Refuse unsupported or ambiguous trigger shapes rather than invent checks; retain ordinary block/scalar/sequence triggers and list activity types. Copy the generator byte-for-byte into its managed runtime bundle. Keep conventional git@host and ssh://git@host[:22] aliases stable while preserving non-default SSH users and ports, bracketed IPv6 and non-default URL ports. Reject embedded passwords and ambiguous URL suffixes without echoing credentials. Tests use text, isolated temporary repositories and synthetic URLs only.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded material patch through protected delivery; preserve existing registered allocation evidence.

validation.evidence: Source and bundled generator agree; sibling types and comments do not suppress or invent PR checks; closed-only PR triggers stay excluded; malformed/unsupported trigger inputs refuse without writes.
Distinct SSH users/nondefault ports stay distinct; conventional aliases stay equal; unsafe/ambiguous origins reject without exposing password text.
Joined version126, full native23, root tests and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev pass before independent approval, protected merge and native immutable release.
